Is it really free?
Yes, every game is free to play and there is nothing to buy on the site. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter, so you can open a game and start playing.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. The games run instantly in your browser, with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, many games are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category. Games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn the phone sideways, and a few older games need a keyboard and mouse and say so on their page.
Is it safe for my kids?
The site only allows family-friendly games, with no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Recently played games, favourites and your light or dark choice are kept in your own browser and never leave your device. Most games save their own progress the same way, so clearing your browser data or using private mode will lose it.
What are the cookie settings about?
If you are in Europe, you are asked before any non-essential cookies are used. You can change your choice at any time with Cookie settings in the footer.
Where do the games come from?

Six games are made by Door 404, the studio that runs the site, and ten were sent in directly by independent developers. The rest are licensed from the distribution networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, and games are never copied from other portals.
How can I submit my own game?

Go to https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. It is free and non-exclusive, and a real person plays every submission. An accepted game gets its own page that credits you and links back to you, while the game stays hosted on your own server.
How do I get my game removed?
Email contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will take it down. Because your game stays on your own server, you can ask for removal at any time.
Can I embed a game on my own website?
You can embed the site's own games, which have an Embed this game box with ready-made code on their page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so they cannot be embedded this way.
How do I reach a real person?
Write to contact@ilovewebgames.com. The site is run by Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia.
